typography.instructions: Use 'Playfair Display' exclusively for H1, H2, and H3 to maintain the regal/ceremonial feel. Use 'Outfit' for body, inputs, and UI elements. Never default to generic Sans fonts like Inter.

colors.instructions: Update src/index.css with these exact HSL values. The app is strictly Light Theme (blush background, white surfaces, deep plum text) to maintain the delicate brand identity. Use vivid hot pink/plum gradients only for hero sections and primary buttons.

visual_enhancers.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) for primary actions. Must use the hot pink primary color. Include a subtle drop-shadow and hover translation (-translate-y-0.5).
visual_enhancers.inputs: Rounded fields (rounded-2xl) with pure white background (bg-white) resting on the blush app background. No heavy borders; use subtle border (border-border).
visual_enhancers.chips: For the 'JADE DYNASTY' branding, use small pill-shaped badges (rounded-full) featuring a Lucide 'Heart' icon, white text, and a semi-transparent white/pink background.
visual_enhancers.gradients: Hero background must use a soft-to-vivid pink/plum gradient. Use CSS gradients like `bg-gradient-to-br from-[#4A0E1B] via-[#FF4E88] to-[#FDF0F4]` or overlapping blurred background blobs.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use for the sticky top navigation bar: `backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70` with a delicate `border-b border-white/40`. NEVER use full transparent backgrounds over scrolling content.

components.strategy: Use pure HTML/Tailwind for the Marketing Landing Page to allow for organic, overlapping layouts and gradients. Use customized Shadcn UI components for the Authenticated Dashboards and Tribute Flow.

shadcn_customizations.button: Override default rounded-md to rounded-full. Add rich hover states.
shadcn_customizations.input: Override default h-9 to h-12, and rounded-md to rounded-2xl. Use bg-white explicitly since the page background is blush.
shadcn_customizations.card: Use shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgba(74,14,27,0.06)] for a soft, premium lift. Set border-radius to rounded-3xl. Remove harsh default borders.
shadcn_customizations.tabs: For tribute selection (frequency/rhythm), use a custom pill-based tab list rather than standard rigid Shadcn tabs.

grids_layouts.marketing_hero: Full viewport height (min-h-[90vh]), heavily reliant on gradient background, large centralized serif typography, and a clear pill-shaped primary CTA.
grids_layouts.tribute_flow: Centered, narrow max-width container (max-w-2xl). Multi-step interface (Amount -> Rhythm -> Payment). Generous padding (p-8 or p-12) inside the main white card to feel premium and unhurried.
grids_layouts.member_dashboard: Bento Grid strategy. Main layout: Side navigation (w-64) + Main content area. Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-6. Dashboard cards should feel like floating white islands on the blush background.
grids_layouts.admin_dashboard: High-density but elegant. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4. Use Shadcn tables with ample row padding. Keep the aesthetic light, clear, and functional.

motion.page_transitions: Use framer-motion for smooth fade and slight slide-up (y: 20 -> y: 0) when entering the tribute flow or transitioning between dashboard views.
motion.micro_interactions: Buttons and selectable tribute cards should scale up slightly (scale: 1.02) and lift (-translate-y-1) on hover with a spring transition.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure white text on hot pink buttons meets APCA standards. Deep plum text on blush background provides excellent contrast natively.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have `data-testid` attributes (e.g., `data-testid="tribute-amount-select"`). Use role-based, kebab-case naming.

A group of people sitting at a long table (elegant gathering)

media.icons: Use `lucide-react`. Required icons include 'Heart' (for the Jade Dynasty chip), 'Crown' (for admin privileges), and 'CreditCard' (for payment methods).

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Install 'Playfair Display' and 'Outfit' fonts via Google Fonts in public/index.html.
2. Update tailwind.config.js and src/index.css strictly with the provided HSL variables.
3. Do NOT implement a dark mode toggle. The application relies entirely on the Light/Blush theme to accurately represent the 'Jade & Co.' branding.
4. Build a custom 'Tribute Flow' using Framer Motion for smooth transitions between steps (Amount -> Rhythm -> Payment).
5. Use standard semantic HTML sections for the marketing landing page, but highly customized Shadcn components for the dashboard areas.
6. Ensure all primary buttons are rounded-full to match the mobile app's pill-shaped button aesthetic.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable. Create new components matching existing style.
Use `sonner` for toasts. Located in `/app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.js` or `.jsx`.
